name: Ángel Alexander Báez Flores
intro: Soy un desarrollador de software con gran interés en el desarrollo full-stack, arquitecturas backend y la inteligencia artificial. Apasionado por construir soluciones que combinan elegancia técnica con impacto real. Creo que el código, como la Fuerza, conecta todo el universo digital.

projects.title: Social Service Project (Sweeper Robot)
projects.shortDesc: Designed and modeled a remote-controlled sweeper robot prototype, integrating circular economy principles by using recycled materials and technical simulation in Tinkercad.
projects.fullDesc: Programmed the central processing unit based on the ESP32 microcontroller, using C++ (Arduino IDE) to manage motor control logic, wireless connectivity, and the response of cleaning actuators. Implemented communication protocols for remote control and designed the electronic circuit architecture. Documented the hardware development cycle.

projects.title: Professional Internship at Giramo S.A. de C.V.
projects.shortDesc: Digitized the construction registration processes by developing a technical web application, optimizing the administrative data flow.
projects.fullDesc: Designed and managed a robust relational database in MySQL using SQL queries, ensuring the integrity and availability of critical project information. Documented the software lifecycle and version control, maintaining a detailed record of modifications and technical requirements.

projects.title: Academic Project "Halo 2D Adventures"
projects.shortDesc: Development of a 2D game engine from scratch.
projects.fullDesc: Developed a 2D game engine from scratch using Python and the Pygame library, implementing collision logic, animated sprites, and game state management. Applied Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles to structure characters, levels, and combat systems.

projects.title: Academic Project "DoomsDay"
projects.shortDesc: Stochastic simulation in Python to calculate the probability of asteroid impact, based on universal gravitation laws.
projects.fullDesc: Programmed a stochastic simulation in Python to calculate the probability of asteroid impact, based on universal gravitation laws and orbital mechanics. Analyzed multiple physical variables (mass, trajectory, velocity) to generate predictive models on terrestrial risk scenarios.

projects.title: Academic Project "Bungee Jumping"
projects.shortDesc: Designed and developed a simulator in MATLAB to model a person's bungee jump, analyzing the physics of motion.
projects.fullDesc: Implemented mathematical models considering free fall, the elastic force of the rope (Hooke's Law), and air resistance to calculate critical variables such as position, velocity, and acceleration using second-order differential equations. Programmed an interactive graphical interface allowing parameter adjustments and used numerical methods to predict the maximum stretch point and avoid collisions.

projects.title: HealthFinder - MLH Hackathon (HackMorelos)
projects.shortDesc: Development of a HealthTech startup with a web platform that facilitates the search for nearby medications and clinical services, comparing prices through geolocation.
projects.fullDesc: Led team management under agile methodologies like Scrum to accelerate the MVP development of the hackathon. Was the main person in charge of designing and implementing the entire backend architecture using Node.js and Express.js. Modeled and developed in MySQL. Implemented algorithmic logic and integration with Leaflet.

projects.title: Social Service - Tribunal Unitario de Justicia Para Adolecentes
Academic Project "Volcanic Eruption"
projects.shortDesc: Computational simulation oriented to civil protection modeling the trajectory of volcanic projectiles to determine the radius of a safe zone facing an eruption.
projects.fullDesc: Developed a numerical model in MATLAB to simulate the ballistic trajectory of volcanic projectiles, considering air resistance and variable gravity. Used differential equation resolution methods to visualize the reach and dispersion of materials in different eruptive scenarios.

projects.title: Academic Project "Magnetic Brake"
projects.shortDesc: Designed a physical simulation on deceleration by Eddy Currents, modeling the electromagnetic braking of an amusement park gondola.
projects.fullDesc: Designed a physical simulation in MATLAB on deceleration by Eddy Currents, modeling the electromagnetic braking of an amusement park gondola. Implemented mathematical models based on Faraday's and Lenz's Laws to optimize the efficiency and safety of the braking system.

projects.title: Academic Project "Streaming Service"
projects.shortDesc: Designed the architecture of a scalable streaming system under the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigm.
projects.fullDesc: Designed the architecture of a scalable streaming system under the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigm. Generated complete technical documentation through UML Class Diagrams, defining inheritance hierarchies, polymorphism, and encapsulation for user and content management. Included REST API development with Node.js and Express.js for the backend.

projects.title: Academic Project "Malaria Propagation"
projects.shortDesc: Designed and developed a mathematical model in MATLAB to simulate the transmission dynamics of malaria between mosquitoes and humans using the Ross-Macdonald epidemiological model.
projects.fullDesc: Implemented a system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) to analyze how variables like bite rate and recovery affect the percentage of infected population over time. Programmed a computational simulation to predict the disease's behavior and evaluate the effectiveness of public health interventions.

projects.title: Academic Project "Hyperbolic Paraboloid"
projects.shortDesc: Designed and developed a computational simulation in MATLAB for the architectural modeling of a chapel, using hyperbolic paraboloid geometry to optimize structural efficiency.
projects.fullDesc: Implemented algorithms based on triple integrals to accurately calculate the required concrete volume and internal air volume for HVAC systems. Programmed a graphical interface for 3D visualization of the structure and developed a calculation module for optimizing formwork and structural supports.

projects.title: Academic Project "Image Processor"
projects.shortDesc: Comparative study and application development to evaluate edge detection algorithms in digital images based on performance and accuracy.
projects.fullDesc: Developed an application in Python implementing computer vision algorithms (Canny, Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts) with Gaussian kernels and non-maximum suppression. Designed a GUI with Tkinter and optimized the system with dynamic binarization using the Roberts algorithm.

projects.title: Academic Project "Microprocessor Simulator"
projects.shortDesc: Designed and developed a functional microprocessor simulator using Assembly language to understand internal architecture and register management.
projects.fullDesc: Implemented execution logic for a custom instruction set, enabling processing of arithmetic and control flow operations directly on the simulated hardware. Programmed memory management and processor state visualization modules, optimizing resource usage at the machine language level to ensure efficient execution.

projects.title: Academic Project "ComposTech"
projects.shortDesc: IoT system for composting automation integrating sensors and remote control.
projects.fullDesc: Led the development of an IoT system with ESP32-S3 (C++/Arduino). Developed the web interface in React.js, HTML, and CSS for real-time monitoring. Designed the backend architecture with Node.js, Express.js, and AWS for database and critical variables. Implemented automated ventilation and irrigation control, managing with Jira (Scrum) and WBS. Documented detailed engineering and circuits.

projects.title: Arcane Codex - Aulify
projects.shortDesc: Led the development of an educational video game developed in Unity (C#) and deployed via WebGL, integrating a dynamic web user interface built with React.js.
projects.fullDesc: Designed and developed the server architecture, implementing a REST API with Node.js, Express.js, and a relational database in MySQL for persistent profile and inventory management. Synchronized real-time client-server data, built an administrative Dashboard for metrics monitoring, and managed the lifecycle under Agile (Scrum) methodologies.

projects.title: Sumo Robot (Regional Competition)
projects.shortDesc: Designed and programmed a remote combat robot using Arduino (C++).
projects.fullDesc: Performed prototyping and circuit simulations in Tinkercad, optimizing energy consumption and actuator response for the regional competition.

projects.title: Autonomous Line Follower Drone (National Competition)
projects.shortDesc: Programmed an autonomous navigation system for a drone to participate in a national competition.
projects.fullDesc: Programmed an autonomous navigation system for a drone using Python and the OpenCV library for edge detection and real-time image processing. Implemented control algorithms for trajectory tracking, successfully participating in a national-level competition.

projects.title: TicketGo - MAC Computadoras
projects.shortDesc: Designed and implemented a REST API for a ticket management system for web and mobile applications.
projects.fullDesc: Implemented the backend in AWS using Node.js and Express.js, ensuring high availability and scalability. Responsible for architecture, development, and backend deployment, ensuring data integrity and efficiency. Managed the project using Agile methodology (Jira) with a React.js frontend and a Kotlin mobile app.

projects.title: Tanuki Sunset Agent - Rewind Games
projects.shortDesc: Development of an AI system for a racing video game, integrating Unity ML-Agents for autonomous agent training and a telemetry subsystem (Ghost System) for recording, optimization, and visualization of optimal routes.
projects.fullDesc: Implemented an agent with Unity ML-Agents architecture, configuring vector observations and reward logic. Developed a persistence module (OptimalLineRecorder) with JSON serialization. Created a visualizer (OptimalLineRenderer) using Physics.Raycast for terrain adaptation and trajectory projection.

projects.title: CICACTA DOCSITE - Center for Research in Applied Science and Advanced Technology
projects.shortDesc: Created a web system for CICATA aimed at generating certificates and centralizing processes in a single system, streamlining these processes and improving time efficiency.
projects.fullDesc: Designed and developed a MySQL database for a certificate generation system. Migrated and adapted the database to Prisma and configured the backend environment with Node.js and Express.js, created REST API endpoints with JavaScript, and documented them with Swagger. Developed the frontend with HTML, CSS, and React.js. Managed the project with Jira using Scrum.

projects.title: Monterrey Institute of Technology and Higher Education
projects.shortDesc: Restructured and modernized a legacy web system using an architecture based on React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, and MySQL.
projects.fullDesc: Designed and implemented REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js to support new system features. Developed the frontend layout with HTML, CSS, and React.js. Documented endpoints using Swagger and used Docker to standardize development and deployment environments. Collaborated to integrate backend services, improving maintainability, scalability, and stability.
